result.summary: Validated src/design/fix-ISS-0106.md (Type E, single artefact, no codegen) against current main at HEAD 9ff3580 / barrier commit 35471e7. The design is faithful, complete, contains no implementation code, and matches the merged implementation byte-for-byte on every load-bearing structural element. Mandatory design lint exits 0. The design: (1) states the root cause precisely — concurrent AccessExclusiveLock-holding raw-conn transactions in tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig race other DDL/migration binaries under Zig's default concurrent sibling scheduling; (2) prescribes the exact structural fix — one intermediate barrier step (test-integration-others-internal, b.step at build.zig:1257) aggregating 21 non-ISS-503 Run steps (lines 1258–1278), with a NEW dedicated Run artifact (run_iss503_integration_tests_after_others, build.zig:1298–1302) carrying the barrier ordering edge and re-attached to the umbrella step; (3) preserves the narrow zig build test-integration-iss503 target by NOT adding the barrier edge onto the shared run_iss503_integration_tests.step (avoiding transitive fan-out to all 21 siblings); (4) explicitly rejects sleep, retry-on-40P01, deadlock-retry wrappers, timeout inflation, COUNT(*) advisory locking alone, pg.zig driver changes, and global serialization as non-solutions, with one-line rationale each; (5) specifies fresh evidence gates: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, zig build test-integration-iss503, and a full zig build test-integration run with case-insensitive scan for any ISS-503 identifier in any deadlock/failure window — with abort conditions if ISS-503 starts concurrently with any sibling; (6) lists affected files (build.zig primary, test_iss503_rls_removal.zig doc-comment-only) and explicitly excludes helpers.zig / vendor/pg/pg.zig / src/db/migrations.zig / db_integration_test.zig from change. tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig carries the exact doc-comment block cross-referencing ISS-0106/#364 and the barrier step (lines 36–49). Closure path for GitHub #364 is unambiguous: BACKEND-DEV certifies no implementation delta (current main already implements the design), runs the five fresh gates, and DOC-UPDATER comments/closes #364 with the gate output as evidence. The local ISS-0106 (RESOLVED) ↔ GitHub #364 (OPEN) mismatch is therefore a documentation/sync gap, not a code defect.
